fiscal_note: Fiscal year ends on the Friday nearest June 30 (FY25 ended 2025-06-27; FY26 was a 53-week year ending 2026-07-03, FQ1 FY26 had 14 weeks). All figures non-GAAP as guided/reported on the calls. BASIS BREAK: SanDisk (Flash) spun off 2025-02-21. FQ1-FQ2 FY25 are total company (Flash+HDD) on both sides; FQ3 FY25 was guided combined but reported HDD-only continuing ops, so its total-company items are comparable=false (only an HDD directional GM guide is gradable); FQ4 FY25 onward is HDD-only on both sides. FMP's earnings calendar/income statement restate FQ1 FY25 revenue to HDD-only ($2,212M) while keeping FQ2 FY25 at total company ($4,285M); the original total-company figure ($4,095M) comes from FMP as-reported statements. Guidance and actuals come from FMP transcripts (all 9 contain full prepared remarks) plus FMP calendar/statements; WD press-release PDFs and BusinessWire could not be read (PDF served as download, BusinessWire access denied), so press releases were not used as a source. Interest/other-expense guidance is omitted (not an allowed metric). Flash-only forward commitments (eSSD mix, 64TB SSD shipments) are excluded because WDC's later calls cannot grade them. Commitment status is as of 2026-10-11 using calls through 2026-08-05. Values marked 'derived' are arithmetic from stated figures.
